visual.title: Six to four as a fraction
visual.caption: A ratio compares two quantities in order. The two tapes show six parts and four parts, and dividing both by two gives the simplified ratio 3 to 2.

predict.question: What is the ratio 6 to 4 in simplest form?
predict.explain: Both terms share the factor 2, so 6 to 4 simplifies to 3 to 2.
